blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks. We trace this puzzle to the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls not because methods fail to propose better artifacts, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across seven evolution methods and six models (over 10M LLM calls), we find support for the hypothesis at both levels where evaluation scores are used. At the candidate level (choosing artifacts), helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection is no better than random at telling them from harmful ones, so errors accumulate across rounds. At the method level (ranking methods), typical margins of a few percentage points are smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method, so published rankings often rest on luck. Together, these findings indicate that agent evolution is often bottlenecked by reliably identifying improvements. This calls for a shift in how we develop and evaluate self-improving agents, from designing ever more candidate improvement systems to making true improvements detectable and accumulable.
blocks.zh: 代理进化遵循一个简单的循环:求婚者会写出候选文物(即时,技能,记忆)并选择接受得分较高的文物. 这个循环显示了希望,然而实践者却面临一个谜题:方法贸易在论文之间获胜,进化过程往往无法解决某些任务。 我们把这个谜题追溯到解析假说: 代理进化的停滞不是因为方法不能提出更好的工艺品,而是因为噪音的评价无法可靠地识别出它们. 在整个7个演化方法和6个模型(超过10M LLM调用)中,我们发现在使用评价分数的两级都支持假设. 在候选(选取文物)一级,有帮助的候选文物存在,但选取并不比从有害文物中随机分辨好,因此错误会相继累积. 在方法层面(分级方法),典型的几个百分点相差小于同一方法的两个独立跑道的相差,因此所公布的排名往往取自运气. 这些调查结果表明,代理人进化往往由于可靠地确定改进而受阻。 这要求我们改变我们如何发展和评价自我改进的代理人,从设计更多的备选改进系统,到使真正的改进可以探测和累积。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Agent evolution improves frozen LLM agents by refining persistent external artifacts such as prompts, skills, memories, and entire agent harnesses.
It typically follows a loop as shown in Figure 1 b: a proposer writes candidate artifacts, the resulting agent is evaluated on a task set, and selection accepts the candidate artifacts that score higher.
Evolution methods of this family have shown promise across benchmarks and models [ 37 , 27 , 24 ] , making the prospect of systems that continuously improve their own workflows increasingly plausible.
blocks.zh:
物剂进化通过精炼持久性的外部文物,如诱因,技能,记忆,以及整个物剂牵引物,来改进冷冻LLM剂.
它通常遵循图1b所示的循环:求婚者写出候选文物,生成的代理被评价在一个任务集上,选择接受得分较高的候选文物.
这个家庭的进化方法在各种基准和模式[37、27、24]中显示出希望,使不断改进自身工作流程的系统的前景越来越乐观。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : (a) Four candidate moves on the same landscape, scored under high and low evaluation noise (thought bubble: score relative to the current artifact). Under high noise, a worse candidate artifact scores highest. (b) Agent evolution as a loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts, and a selector accepts the artifacts with the highest noisy score. P1–P3 are the predictions we test in Section 5 .

blocks.en:
Yet the picture is far from settled.
Studies often reach conflicting conclusions: the same methods flip between effective and ineffective across benchmarks, and their rankings trade places across papers.
On Terminal-Bench [ 22 ] and other coding-agent benchmarks, evolution methods have repeatedly been reported to stall [ 29 , 17 , 7 ] , while on other benchmarks each new method claims to outperform its predecessors [ 43 , 18 , 24 , 31 ] .
Whether evolution helps depends on the setting in ways the community cannot yet predict.
blocks.zh:
然而,情况远未确定。
研究往往得出相互矛盾的结论:同样的方法在基准之间发生效力和效力的翻转,其交易排名在文件之间。
在终端-Bench [22] 和其他编码代理基准上,不断报告演化方法拖延[29、17、7],而在其他基准上,每种新方法都声称其业绩超过其前身[43、18、24、31]。
进化是否有助于以社区尚无法预测的方式决定环境。

blocks.en:
This instability erodes confidence in this direction in both academia and industry, and rewards whichever method happened to be luckier at evaluation time.
Yet unreliable evaluation affects more than the reported rankings of evolution methods.
At the candidate level, the same kind of evaluation decides which artifacts to carry forward to the next round.
As a result, the evolution methods themselves become unreliable.
blocks.zh:
这种不稳定性削弱了学术界和工业界对这个方向的信心,而且无论哪种方法在评价时都更幸运,都会得到奖励。
然而,评价的不可靠影响比所报告的演化方法的排名还要大。
在候选级别上,同一种评价决定哪些文物要延续到下一轮.
因此,进化方法本身变得不可靠.

blocks.en:
We argue that this evaluation rests on an untested premise that its scores can identify the improvements evolution brings.
We find that the premise fails at both levels where the scores are used.
At the method level, the margins that separate methods in papers are smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method:
on Terminal-Bench, current common practice (Appendix D.3 ) can only identify the truly best of four text-artifact methods 33% of the time, barely above a random guess (Section 4 ).
At the candidate level, the selector picks the better of two candidate artifacts only about half the time, no better than a coin flip (Section 5.2 ).
Because each round accepts the artifact that happened to score highest, the scores go up but the artifacts do not get better (Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们认为,这一评价是基于一个未经检验的前提,即它的分数可以确定演变带来的改进。
我们发现,在使用分数的两个级别,前提都失败了。
在方法层面,纸上分离方法的差值小于同一方法的两个独立流的差值:
在Terminal-Bench上,当前常见的做法(附录D.3 )只能识别四种文本艺术方法中真正最好的一种:33%的时间,几乎高于随机猜测(第4节)。
在候选级别上,选手只选择了大约一半的时间来选择两个候选文物中的好,并不比硬币翻转更好(第5.2节).
由于每一回合都接受偶然得分最高的文物,所以得分上升,但文物并没有好转(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: Both failures trace to a single constraint, which we state as a hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 这两种失败都与我们所说的一种假设相一致。

blocks.en: The Resolution Hypothesis. The bottleneck of agent evolution is identifying which artifacts bring improvement, not proposing them.
blocks.zh: 解析假说. 物剂进化的瓶颈是确定哪些文物带来改进,而不是提出.

blocks.en:
Why is identifying improvements so hard? Because model weights are frozen, an artifact helps only by changing the model’s behavior at inference time, while LLM trajectories also vary each time the agent attempts a task.
As a result, separating a true behavioral change from evaluation noise is difficult. We define the resolution of an evaluation pipeline as the smallest true improvement it can reliably distinguish from noise.
Once the true improvement falls below this resolution, candidate selection degrades to chance, so little improvement accumulates during evolution (Figure 1 a).
Proposal determines how large the improvements on offer are; resolution determines how small an improvement can be and still be reliably identified.
blocks.zh:
为什么很难确定改进之处? 因为模型重量被冻结,所以一件文物只有在推论时间改变模型的行为才有帮助,而LLM轨迹在代理尝试一项任务时也会有变化.
因此,将真正的行为变化与评价噪声区分开来是困难的. 我们把解决评价管道定义为它能够可靠地区别于噪音的最小的真正改进。
一旦真正的改善低于该决议,候选人的甄选就会沦为偶然,因此在演变过程中几乎没有多少改进(图1a)。
提案决定了要约的改进有多大;决议决定了改进有多大,而且仍然是可靠的。

blocks.en:
We test this hypothesis at a much larger scale than current practice.
Whereas prior work typically relies on a single evolution run (Appendix D.3 ), we run each method 8 times per model and benchmark and evaluate each resulting artifact up to 16 times, totaling 1,030 independent evolution runs and over 2.1 million test trajectories.
In total, the study covers seven agent evolution methods over six models and four agent benchmarks, plus nine further benchmarks on which we re-examine previously reported gains; to our knowledge, it is the largest reproducibility study of agent evolution to date. Our findings are: • Method level (Section 4 ). Typical method margins are smaller than what a single run can identify.
The large historically reported gains are the clearest instance of our hypothesis: on those benchmarks, evolution succeeds by exploiting evaluation shortcuts that lift nearly every task at once, producing gains large enough to exceed the resolution of the evaluation, and stalls once the evaluation is repaired (Section 4.2 ). • Candidate level (Section 5 ). We derive three predictions from the hypothesis. All three are supported by our experiments on Terminal-Bench: P1 Candidate pools contain artifacts that genuinely improve task performance: proposal is not the bottleneck (Section 5.1 ). P2 Common selection mechanisms—whether based on execution scores or LLM judgments—perform near chance at identifying the better of two candidate artifacts (Section 5.2 ). P3 Per-round selection errors compound across rounds, producing the large differences between independent runs of the same method that flip rankings (Section 5.3 ).

blocks.en:
In conclusion, these findings suggest a different perspective on agent evolution. The proposer determines what improvements are available, but evaluation resolution determines which improvements can be retained and accumulated. When this resolution is insufficient, true improvements are lost in noise, while large, easily detectable changes can dominate the evolution process even when they exploit evaluation shortcuts.
Progress requires either enlarging the improvements being proposed or making smaller improvements reliably detectable.
More broadly, developing higher-resolution feedback may be as important as developing more powerful evolution algorithms.
blocks.zh:
最后,这些结论对代理人演化提出了不同的观点. 提议者决定有哪些改进可用,但评价分辨率决定哪些改进可以保留和累积。 当这个分辨率不足时,真正的改进在噪音中丢失,而巨大的,容易察觉的变化即使在利用评价捷径时也能支配进化过程.
要取得进展,就需要扩大所提出的改进,或使较小的改进能够可靠地被察觉。
更广泛地说,开发高分辨率反馈可能与开发更强大的演化算法同样重要.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Agent evolution methods share a common propose-evaluate-select loop but vary in what they evolve: prompts [ 2 ] , skills [ 24 , 37 ] , memories [ 43 , 27 ] , or executable code [ 18 , 42 ] .
Several analyses document the fragility of this paradigm, e.g., sensitivity to run-to-run variance and task order [ 39 ] , sparse feedback-dependent gains [ 19 ] , and skill-induced failures or contamination from uncontrolled accumulation [ 17 , 7 , 29 ] .
These findings point to noisy selection as a shared failure mode, connecting to best-arm identification [ 12 ] , uncertainty-aware RL evaluation [ 1 ] , and the false-commit analysis of PACE [ 30 ] .
Our work isolates the mechanism: we separate evaluation noise from run-to-run variance and use controlled pools to test proposal quality and selection reliability independently.
Appendix A gives a full discussion.
blocks.zh:
代理演化方法共享一个共同的提议评价-选择循环,但其演化过程各不相同:导出[2],技能[24,37],记忆[43,27],或可执行代码[18,42].
一些分析记录了这一范式的脆弱性,例如,对运行中的差异和任务顺序的敏感性[39],依赖反馈的收益稀少[19],以及技能导致的失败或不受控制的积累造成的污染[17、7、29]。
这些调查结果表明,选择的噪音是共同的失败模式,它与最佳武器识别[12]、对不确定性的认识的RL评价[1]和对PACE[30]的虚假承诺分析相连接。
我们的工作将这一机制隔离开来:我们把评价噪声与运行中的差异分开,并使用控制池独立测试建议书的质量和选择可靠性。

blocks.en: 3 Variance Decomposition and Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 差异分解和实验设置

blocks.en:
To determine whether benchmark scores can identify improvements, we first need a formal model that separates the stochasticity of the evolution algorithm from the noise of the evaluation instrument.
This section defines the variance decomposition and outlines our experiments.
blocks.zh:
为了确定基准分数能否识别改进,我们首先需要一种正式的模型,将演化算法的线性与评价仪器的噪声区分开来.
本节定义差异分解,并概述我们的实验.

blocks.en: 3.2 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3.2 实验

blocks.en:
We study seven evolution methods in two families. Four text-artifact methods evolve text given to the agent: prompts (GEPA [ 2 ] ), skills (SkillOpt-Lite [ 31 ] , Trace2Skill [ 24 ] ), and memory playbooks (ReasoningBank [ 27 ] ). Three harness methods evolve the agent’s scaffolding (HarnessLens [ 36 ] , Meta-Harness [ 15 ] , AHE [ 18 ] ).
We use six agent models: GPT-5.4 nano [ 25 ] , GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra [ 26 ] , DeepSeek-V4-Flash [ 6 ] , Kimi-K3 [ 13 ] , and GLM-5.2 [ 9 , 41 ] .
Model coverage follows cost: the cheaper experiments use all six models and the more expensive ones a subset.
The experiments fall into four groups: • Variance measurement (Section 4.1 ). All seven methods on ALFWorld [ 32 ] , SpreadsheetBench [ 20 ] , OfficeQA [ 5 ] , and Terminal-Bench v2.1 [ 22 ] , each evolved and evaluated repeatedly to estimate τ \tau and σ \sigma . • Gain audit (Section 4.2 ). The largest reported gains on twelve benchmarks, the first three above and nine from the methods’ original papers, re-examined under the released and repaired evaluations; on four of them, we also re-evolve the methods under the repaired evaluations. • Candidate pools (Sections 5.1 and 5.2 ). Without loss of generality, we use text-based skills to test proposal quality and selection reliability in isolation, constructing two pools of n = 100 n{=}100 skills tailored to each question (Appendix F.1 ): a Proposal Pool (Section 5.1 ) generated on 10 Terminal-Bench v2.1 training tasks and evaluated on 10 disjoint test tasks (16 rollouts per pair) to measure out-of-sample proposal gains, and a Selection Pool (Section 5.2 ) combining candidates from Terminal-Bench and DeepSWE trajectories across 11 difficulty-stratified Terminal-Bench tasks (8 to 15 rollouts per pair) to benchmark selection rules and trajectory judges. • Trajectory re-evaluation (Section 5.3 ). Every intermediate artifact of eight SkillOpt-Lite and eight GEPA evolution runs on Terminal-Bench, re-evaluated eight times per task. blocks.en: 4 Resolution at the Method Level
blocks.zh: 4 方法一级的决议

blocks.en: With both variance components measured, we can test whether standard evaluation practice can identify the method differences these papers report.
blocks.zh: 通过衡量这两个差异部分,我们可以测试标准评价做法是否能够确定这些文件报告的方法差异。

blocks.en: 4.1 Single Reports Cannot Rank Methods
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 单一报告 无法排序方法

blocks.en:
For each method, model, and benchmark, we run evolution 8 times independently (16 times for the text-artifact methods on GPT-5.4 nano) and evaluate each resulting artifact 16 times on the held-out test split (8 times on Terminal-Bench and for harness methods).
The unevolved baseline is evaluated equally often.
We call a method or the unevolved baseline on a given model and benchmark a configuration ; in total, these experiments comprise 150 configurations, 1,030 independent evolution runs, and over 2.1 million test trajectories.
We estimate σ \sigma from how much repeated evaluations of the same artifact differ, and τ \tau from how much the mean scores of the artifacts from different runs differ (Appendix B.2 ).
blocks.zh:
对于每一种方法,模型,和基准,我们独立运行进化8次(GPT-5.4纳米的文本艺术方法为16次),并在停机测试分拆(终端-奔驰8次,以及牵引方法)上评价每个结果的文物16次.
未变动的基线也得到同样的评价。
我们称特定模型上的方法或未演化基线为配置;这些实验共包括150个配置,1,030个独立演化运行,以及超过210万个测试轨迹。
我们从对同一文物的反复评价中估计出 & sigma 的差别, 以及 \ tau 与不同运行的文物的平均分差多少(附录 B.2 ) 。

blocks.en:
The standard deviation of the evaluation noise, σ \sigma , ranges from 1.0 to 3.7 percentage points (pp) on SpreadsheetBench, OfficeQA, and ALFWorld, and reaches 4.5 pp on Terminal-Bench, while run-to-run standard deviation τ \tau ranges from 0 to 12.3 pp.
Together, a method evolved once and evaluated once has a typical score standard deviation of 1.7 to 4.1 pp, the median over the configurations of each benchmark (values for every configuration: Table 6 ).
Most method differences are smaller than this: for over 60% of pairs of configurations on the same model and benchmark, the gap between their all-run means falls below one standard deviation of a single-run comparison (Figure 2 a).
The result holds method by method: for every method, 53% to 79% of its comparisons fall below one single-run standard deviation (Appendix D.1 ).
blocks.zh:
在电子表格Bench,OfficeQA,和ALFWorld上,评价噪声的标准差为1.0至3.7个百分点(pp),在终端-Bench上达到4.5pp,而运行到运行的标准差为0至12.3pp.
一种方法一并演化出来,一次被评价,其典型的得分标准差为1.7至4.1pp,在每个基准的配置之上的中位数(每个配置的值:表6 ).
大多数方法差异都小于此:对于同一模型和基准上超过60%的组合组合,其全运行手段之间的差距低于单运行比较的一个标准偏差(图2 a).
结果是按方法得出的:对于每一种方法,53%至79%的比较低于单一运行标准差(附录D.1)。

blocks.en:
Across 171 benchmark–model results in the main tables of nine agent-evolution papers, the proposed method leads its strongest competitor by a median of 3.4 pp, with an interquartile range of 1.2 to 6.6 pp.
None of these results reports a variance estimate, and only 6 average over more than one evolution run. Appendix D.3 lists the surveyed results.
blocks.zh:
在171份基准模型中,有9份代理演进文件的主要表格显示,拟议方法以3.4pp的中位数领先其最强的竞争对手,其中方位范围为1.2-6.6pp。
这些结果都未报告差异估计数,在一次以上的演化中平均只有6次。 附录D.3列出了调查的结果。

blocks.en:
Identifying a true margin Δ \Delta at 80% power with α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 requires N ≥ 2 ⋅ ( z 1 − α / 2 + z 1 − β Δ ) 2 ⋅ ( τ 2 + σ 2 ) N\geq 2\cdot\left(\frac{z_{1-\alpha/2}+z_{1-\beta}}{\Delta}\right)^{2}\cdot(\tau^{2}+\sigma^{2}) (2) independent runs per method.
At the median reported margin of 3.4 pp, this means about 5 runs on SpreadsheetBench, 10 on OfficeQA, 19 on ALFWorld, and 23 on Terminal-Bench (181 on Terminal-Bench at the lower-quartile margin) (Figure 2 b).
A single run cannot rank methods whose true difference is this small: a results table with one run per method picks the best of the four text-artifact methods only 51% to 73% of the time on SpreadsheetBench, OfficeQA, and ALFWorld, and only 33% on Terminal-Bench, where evaluation noise is largest; a random guess gets 25%.
Appendix D.2 gives the full distribution and the ranking simulation.

blocks.en: 4.2 Large Reported Gains Come from Evaluation Shortcuts
blocks.zh: 4.2 报告的重大收益来自评价快捷键

blocks.en:
Section 4.1 shows that typical method differences are too small for current evaluation to identify.
Some benchmarks, however, show gains of 10 to 40 pp, far above the resolution of a single run, both in the original papers and in our own runs, for example on SpreadsheetBench and LiveMathematicianBench (Appendix E.1 ). This suggests that evolution can find large improvements after all.
The Resolution Hypothesis predicts exactly this pattern: evolution can accumulate an improvement only if the true improvement exceeds the resolution.
An evaluation shortcut can produce such an improvement: a single behavior that the evaluation rewards on most tasks of a benchmark at once yields a gain large enough for even a noisy evaluation to identify.
We test this prediction by auditing the largest reported gains on twelve benchmarks with three models, using two tests (design in Appendix E ).
blocks.zh:
第4.1节显示,典型的方法差异太小,无法进行目前的评价。
然而,有些基准显示,在10至40页的成绩远高于单次运行的分辨率,无论是在最初的论文还是在我们自己的运行中,例如在电子表格Bench和Live Mathematician Bench(附录E.1 )上。 这表明进化毕竟可以找到很大的改进.
分辨率假设完全预测了这种模式:只有当真正的改进超过分辨率时,进化才能累积改进.
一种评价快捷方式可以产生这样的改进:一种单一的行为,即评价一时奖励基准的大多数任务,就能产生足够大的增益,即使是吵闹的评价也能确定.
我们利用两个测试(附录E的设计),通过审计12个基准中报告的最大收益来测试这一预测。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : (a) Unevolved baseline plus one rule. (b) Same artifacts under the repaired evaluation (per-pair values: Appendix E.2 ). The largest reported gains are reproduced by one sentence and vanish after repair.
blocks.zh: 图3:(a) 未演变的基准加一项规则。 (b) 被修复评估的相同文物(每帕价值:附录E.2)。 所报告的最大收益用一句话重复,在修理后消失。

blocks.en:
Evolved artifacts contain many instructions, so a large gain could come from many improvements or from a single one.
To find out, we audit, instruction by instruction, the artifacts released with GEPA and SkillOpt-Lite and those we evolved ourselves (an LLM agent flags candidate instructions, and we check each by hand), and append to the unevolved baseline only the one rule that appears most responsible for the gain.
This single sentence nearly matches what full evolution achieved (Figure 3 a): across the 27 model–benchmark pairs with a reported gain above 3 pp, it recovers a median of 90% of the gain.
The rule typically takes an evaluation shortcut: it adapts to a grader that credits only one answer format, or to a version of the benchmark, released with a method, that departs from the official evaluation (Table 9 ).
Appendix E.2 discusses the exceptions.
blocks.zh:
进化的文物包含许多指示,因此可以从许多改进或单项获得巨大的收益.
为了发现这一点,我们通过指令来审核,通过GEPA和SkillOpt-Lite发行的文物以及我们自己进化出来的文物(LLM代理说明书,我们各自亲手检查),在未演变的基线上只附加了似乎对收益负有最大责任的一条规则.
此句几乎与完全进化的成就(图3a)相吻合:在27个模型-基准对中,报告的收益超过3页,它回收了收益的90%的中位数。
该规则通常采用评价快捷方式:它适应只记入一个答案格式的分级器,或适应使用方法发布的基准版本,该版本不同于官方评价(表9).
附录E.2讨论了例外情况。

blocks.en:
We then repair each evaluation that admits a shortcut, restoring the official evaluation or grading answers by meaning rather than surface form, and re-score the same artifacts.
The median gain falls from 17.6 to 0.8 pp (Figure 3 b), and on several benchmarks the repaired baseline leaves little headroom at all.
Re-running the text-artifact methods under the repaired evaluations does not bring the gain back (Appendix E.3 ).
blocks.zh:
然后,我们修复每一个承认捷径的评价,恢复官方评价或按意义而不是表面形式对答案进行分级,并重新对同样的文物进行分数。
中值收益从17.6页降至0.8页(图3b),根据若干基准,修复后的基线完全没有多少头室。
在修复的评价下重新运行文本渲染方法不会带来收益(附录E.3).

blocks.en:
This controlled contrast supports our argument: evolution succeeds when an artifact delivers an improvement large enough to exceed the resolution, and fails when only small, task-specific improvements remain.
Two questions follow: do such small improvements exist at all, and if so, why does selection fail to accept them?
blocks.zh:
这种可控对比支持了我们的论点:当一件文物能够提供足以超过分辨率的改进时,进化是成功的,而当只有小的、针对具体任务的改进仍然存在时,进化是失败的。
下面是两个问题:这种小的改进是否确实存在,如果存在,为什么选择不接受?

blocks.en: 5 Resolution at the Candidate Level
blocks.zh: 5. 候选人一级的决议

blocks.en:
Progress within an evolution run depends on two conditions: proposals must offer true improvements, and selection must identify them.
We examine both conditions on frozen candidate pools (Sections 5.1 and 5.2 ), then follow how selection errors behave across rounds (Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh:
演化过程中的进展取决于两个条件:提案必须提供真正的改进,选择必须确定。
我们审查冻结候选人人才库的两个条件(第5.1和5.2节),然后了解各轮甄选错误的表现(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Helpful Artifacts Exist
blocks.zh: 5.1 帮助人造武器

blocks.en: Testing P1. To observe what a proposer produces before selection filters candidates out, we construct the Proposal Pool : n = 100 n{=}100 candidate skills generated offline by a SkillOpt-Lite-based proposer from trajectories on 10 Terminal-Bench v2.1 training tasks, and evaluated across 10 disjoint test tasks with 16 independent rollouts per skill–task pair (16,000 rollouts total; protocol in Appendix F.1 ).
blocks.zh: 测试P1. 为了观察一个提议者在筛选出候选人之前产生什么,我们构建了提议池:n = 100 n = 100 n = 100 候选人技能,这些技能是由来自10个终端-Bench v2.1培训任务轨迹的SkillOpt-Lite提议者在网络上产生的,并用16个独立推出的每组技能(总共16,000个推出;附录F.1中的协议)对10个脱节测试任务进行评价。

blocks.en:
If a proposer writes K K candidate skills and we keep the strongest one for each task, does task performance genuinely improve as K K grows?
The solid curves in Figure 4 a track this quantity, Quality@ K K , defined as the expected success rate of the best among K K randomly drawn skills.
Under a 2-hour execution budget (blue solid curve), which allows multi-step solutions to run to completion, Quality@ K K climbs steadily from 49.2 % 49.2\% at K = 1 K{=}1 to 61.8 % 61.8\% at K = 100 K{=}100 .
Under Terminal-Bench’s shorter original timeouts (charcoal solid curve), overall success starts lower ( 39.7 % 39.7\% at K = 1 K{=}1 ) because slow trajectories are cut short, yet Quality@ K K still rises to 51.6 % 51.6\% at K = 100 K{=}100 .
blocks.zh:
如果一个求婚者写出K K候选人的技能,而我们为每项任务保留最强的技能,那么随着K K的成长,任务的表现是否真的有所改善?
图4中的固态曲线是跟踪这一数量, Quality@ K K K, 定义为K K 随机抽取技能中最优秀的预期成功率 。
在2小时的执行预算(蓝色固态曲线)下,允许多步解决方案运行到完成,质量@ KK稳步攀升,从49.2% 49.2% = K = 1 K = 1 K = 1 到 61.8% 61.8% K = 100 K = 100 K = 100
在Bench终点站较短的原定超时(焦炭固态曲线)下,总体成功率开始较低(K=1KQX1,39.7%),因为慢轨距缩短,但质量却较低@ KK仍然上升至51.6%的51.6\%在K=100K{=}100.

blocks.en:
Because taking the maximum over K K noisy evaluations would curve upward even if all 100 skills were identical, each solid curve in Figure 4 a is paired with a dashed equal-quality null —the curve produced when all 100 candidates share the same true success rate and pass through the same empirical-Bayes estimator (Appendix F.2 ).
The vertical gap between the solid and dashed curves isolates genuine skill differences from sampling luck.
In both timeout regimes, the observed curve pulls clearly above its dashed null by K = 5 K{=}5 and maintains a + 3.3 +3.3 to + 3.4 +3.4 pp lead at K = 100 K{=}100 (with intermediate timeout cutoffs in Appendix F.1 ).
Generating more candidates thus yields genuinely stronger skills, with gains comparable to the post-repair method margins in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh:
由于在K K 上进行最大噪音评价,即使所有100种技能都完全相同,也会向上弯曲,图4 a 中的每个固态曲线都与破碎的同等质量的无效曲线成对——当所有100名候选人都具有相同的真正成功率并经过相同的实证-Bayes估计器时产生的曲线(附录F.2)。
固体曲线与破碎曲线之间的垂直差距将真正的技能差异与采样运气隔离开来.
在两种超时制中,观测到的曲线拉力明显高于K=5K{=}5的虚线,并在K=100K{=}100时保持一个+3.3+3.3至+3.4+3.4 pp的铅(附录F.1中的中间断时)。
因此,产生更多的候选人,将产生真正更强的技能,其收益可与第4.2节的维修后方法差值相比。

blocks.en:
While Quality@ K K allows each task to pick its own best skill, a single skill can also improve performance across all 10 test tasks at once.
Averaged over all 160 test rollouts per candidate, individual skills in the Proposal Pool span more than 15 percentage points: under the 2-hour budget, the strongest shared skill ( artifact-063 ) reaches 57.5 % 57.5\% compared with the 49.2 % 49.2\% pool mean ( + 8.3 +8.3 pp) and 41.9 % 41.9\% for the weakest skill, with a similar + 8.4 +8.4 pp lead under the original timeout ( 48.1 % 48.1\% vs. 39.7 % 39.7\% ).
Appendix I.1 inspects representative shared and task-specific skills from our candidate pools to show what these improvements look like in practice.

blocks.en: 5.2 Selection Cannot Identify Them
blocks.zh: 5.2 选择无法识别 他们

blocks.en:
Testing P2. Because candidate pools contain helpful skills (Section 5.1 ) yet evolution fails to accumulate them, we next isolate the selection step.
We construct the Selection Pool : n = 100 n{=}100 skills generated from trajectories on Terminal-Bench and DeepSWE, evaluated across 11 Terminal-Bench tasks spanning five difficulty levels (Appendix F.1 ).
Each selector observes only the first rollout (two rollouts for native SkillOpt-Lite and GEPA selection), while true skill quality is measured on the remaining held-out rollouts (Appendix F.3 ).
We test whether standard selectors choose better skills more often than chance.
blocks.zh:
测试P2. 由于候选人人才库中包含有用的技能(第5.1节),然而进化未能积累这些技能,我们接下来就孤立了选拔步骤.
我们构建选择池:n = 100 n = 100 n = 100 技能来自终端-Bench和DeepSWE的轨迹,在跨越五个难度等级的11个终端-Bench任务中进行评估(附录F.1 )。
每个选择者只观察第一次推出(两次推出土著SkillOpt-Lite和GEPA选择),而真正的技能质量则根据其余的搁置推出(附录F.3)进行衡量。
我们测试标准选择者是否更经常地选择更好的技能而不是机会.

blocks.en:
Greedy accept/reject on execution scores, if effective, would accept improvements and reject regressions with high reliability.
Table 1 and the rank correlation below show the opposite on all three metrics.
In head-to-head comparisons, execution-based selection prefers the better artifact only 49.7% of the time, statistically indistinguishable from the 50% achieved by random selection.
Regressions make up 30.5% of the pool but 62.1% of accepted candidates, so selection does not filter out regressions; the wide interval leaves open whether it is worse than random acceptance.
The rank correlation between a single execution score and posterior artifact quality is 0.054, essentially zero.
The native parent-selection operators of SkillOpt-Lite and GEPA, which observe two rollouts per artifact rather than one, achieve 48.6% pairwise accuracy.
Every execution-based selector in this study is statistically indistinguishable from random choice.
blocks.zh:
贪婪接受/拒绝执行分数,如果有效,将接受改进并拒绝可靠性高的倒退.

在头与头的比较中,基于执行的选取更倾向于49.7%的时间里更好的文物,从统计学上讲,与随机选取达到的50%是无法区分的.
退位占人才库的30.5%,但占被录取候选人的62.1%,因此选拔不会过滤退位;宽间隔留空,是否比随机录取差.
单行刑分数与后期文物质量的等级关系为0.054,基本为零.
SkillOpt-Lite和GEPA的本地父母选择操作人员,每件文物两件而不是一件,均实现了48.6%的对称精确度。

Model-based judges are a natural candidate for restoring identification, because they read the full trajectory rather than a single terminal outcome [ 45 , 43 ] . So one might hope they could tell helpful artifacts from harmful ones.
Table 1 shows that this additional evidence does not help.
No judge exhibits reliable pairwise accuracy.
This may be because the judge has limited ability, while its reading noise is independent of evaluation noise. The two therefore accumulate rather than cancel out, introducing additional noise into the evaluation process.

blocks.en: 5.3 Noise Accumulates Across Rounds
blocks.zh: 5.3 各个回合的噪音累积

blocks.en:
Testing P3. Section 5.2 showed that individual selection steps discriminate at chance level.
An evolution run applies such a step in every round, so the relevant quantity is the cumulative effect of per-round errors over rounds.
blocks.zh:
P3. 第5.2节显示,个人甄选步骤在机会层面存在歧视。
演化运行在每个回合中都应用这样的步骤,因此相关数量是每回合误差的累积效应.

blocks.en:
Near-chance selection implies that most of the gain a run records in its own validation scores, its in-loop gain, should disappear under careful re-evaluation.
This is what the re-evaluation shows.
We independently re-evaluate every artifact produced by eight evolution runs of SkillOpt-Lite and eight of GEPA on the same Terminal-Bench validation set, with eight rollouts per artifact–task pair where evolution used one (protocol in Appendix G ).
In-loop gains grow to 6.9 to 9.0 pp over the course of evolution, while re-evaluated gains remain between + 0.4 +0.4 and − 3.2 -3.2 pp (Figure 5 ).
The mechanism follows from the acceptance rule, which compares a candidate’s noisy score against the current artifact’s and therefore accepts lucky draws from the upper tail of the noise distribution round after round [ 3 , 30 ] .
In-loop scores improve under this process; agent capability does not.
blocks.zh:
近距离选择意味着,在仔细的重新评价下,在自己的验证分数中,大部分的运行记录,即在运行中的收益,都应消失.
这就是重新评价显示的。
我们独立地重新评价了由SkillOpt-Lite和GEPA的8个进化组在同一个终端-Bench验证组上生产的每件文物,其中每个文物的8个任务组使用一个任务组(附录G中的规范)。
在进化过程中,减产收益增长到6.9至9.0pp,而重新评价的收益保持在+0.4+0.4至−3.2-3.2pp之间(图5)。
接受规则将候选人的吵闹分数与现在的艺术品相比较,

Per-round selection errors also drive independent runs apart.
All runs begin from the same artifact, so τ 0 2 = 0 \tau^{2}_{0}=0 , and each round of noisy selection is one more step of an unguided random walk over artifact space.
By the final round, the corrected run-to-run variance τ ^ t 2 \hat{\tau}^{2}_{t} reaches 4.2 to 24.5 squared pp across method–model groups (Figure 6 ; estimation details in Appendix G ).
Independent runs of one method now differ by as much as the margins that separate methods in the literature, which is the instability documented in Section 4 .
These results support P3: per-round selection errors compound across rounds and produce the run-to-run variance behind the ranking instability between methods.

这些结果支持了P3:每轮选择错误复合到各轮,并产生方法之间排名不稳定背后的运行中的差异.

blocks.en: In summary, the variance that prevents a single selection step from identifying improvement is the same variance that destabilizes rankings between methods, compounded over rounds.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,阻碍单一甄选步骤确定改进之处的差异,是造成方法之间排名不稳定的同样差异,这在轮次中更为复杂。

blocks.en: 6 Towards Better Evaluation Resolution
blocks.zh: 6 争取更好地解决评价问题

blocks.en: Because low evaluation resolution limits both candidate selection (Section 5 ) and method comparison (Section 4 ), we examine two practical ways to detect improvements that terminal pass/fail scores miss: finer-grained behavioral checks at the candidate level, and separate evaluations of proposers and selectors at the method level.
blocks.zh: 由于评价分辨率低限制了候选人的甄选(第5节)和方法比较(第4节),我们研究了两种切实可行的方法,以发现终端合格/不及格分数差的改进:在候选人一级进行行为检查,在方法一级对提议者和选择者进行单独评价。

blocks.en:
Terminal pass/fail rewards may obscure improvements in specific agent behaviors.
A promising direction is to supplement them with programmatic checks of intermediate behavior, such as unmasked failure diagnostics on verification commands or whether the agent runs a test after editing a file.
Such checks do not fix selection by themselves, since an artifact that triggers more intermediate checks need not solve more tasks.
They are however cheap diagnostics: in preliminary analysis (Appendix H ), unmasked-diagnostic check rates exhibit 13 × 13\times – 57 × 57\times lower evaluation noise than terminal pass/fail verdicts (Table 13 ), and post-edit verification rates expose behavioral shifts that terminal verdicts miss.
blocks.zh:
终端通行证/失效奖励可能会掩盖特定代理行为方面的改进.
一个很有希望的方向是用对中间行为的程序检查来补充它们,例如核查命令上的未装模作样的故障诊断,或者代理人是否在编辑文件后进行测试.
这种检查本身不能固定选择,因为触发更多中间检查的文物不需要解决更多任务.
然而,它们都是廉价的诊断:在初步分析(附录H)中,未蒙面-诊断检查率显示为13×13\时 — 57×57次评价噪音低于终端通行证/故障判决(表13),编辑后核查率暴露了终端判决失败的行为转变。

blocks.en:
Rather than comparing evolution methods only through noisy end-to-end scores, we encourage evaluating their components separately.
For proposers, Quality@K curves measure the quality of the best candidate among K K proposals (Section 5.1 ).
For selectors, selected-artifact quality curves measure the quality recovered from a fixed candidate pool as the budget grows (Section 5.2 ).
These diagnostics do not replace end-to-end evaluation, but they split one comparison that falls below the resolution into two that exceed it, revealing whether stagnation lies in proposal or in selection even when method-level margins are below the resolution of a single run.
At the reporting level, publishing both evaluation noise ( σ ^ \hat{\sigma} ) and run-to-run variance ( τ ^ \hat{\tau} ) alongside point scores lets readers judge directly whether a claimed margin exceeds the evaluation’s resolution.
blocks.zh:
与其仅仅通过吵闹的端对端得分来比较进化方法,我们鼓励分别评价它们的成分.
对提议者而言,质量@ K曲线在K提案中衡量最佳候选人的质量(第5.1节)。
对于选择者,选定的工艺质量曲线衡量随着预算增长从固定候选人库中回收的质量(第5.2节)。
这些诊断并不取代端对端评价,但将一个低于分辨率的比较分成两个超过分辨率的比较,揭示即使方法层面的差值低于一次运行的分辨率,还是停滞在于提案还是选择.
在报告层面,公布评价噪声(\\\ hat\ sigma})和跑到跑的差数(\\ \ tau})以及点数让读者直接判断所主张的差值是否超过评价的解决范围。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We propose a hypothesis that agent evolution is bottlenecked not by proposing helpful artifacts but by identifying them.
We provide evidence for this at both levels where evaluation scores are used: the margins separating published methods are comparable to the fluctuation of a single run, so single-run rankings are largely determined by noise; helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection identifies them no better than chance, and these errors accumulate into run-to-run variance.
The largest reported gains are consistent with this limit from the other side—they exploit evaluation shortcuts and vanish once the evaluation is repaired.
As a promising direction for future research, we suggest making evaluations resolution-aware: less noisy intermediate process metrics, component-wise diagnostics for proposers and selectors, and variance reporting that lets readers judge whether a claimed margin exceeds the resolution.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个假设,即代理人进化的瓶颈不是通过提出有帮助的文物,而是通过识别这些文物。
在使用评价分数的两个级别,我们提供这方面的证据:将公布的方法分开的差值与单次跑的波动相当,所以单次跑的排名主要是由噪音决定的;有有用的候选文物,但选择的发现并不比机会好,这些错误累积为逐次跑的差额。
所报告的最大收益与另一方的这一限制一致——它们利用评价捷径,一旦评价修复就消失。
作为未来研究的一个有希望的方向,我们建议使评价认识到分辨率:不太吵闹的中间过程度量,对提议者和选择者进行构件诊断,以及让读者判断所声称的差值是否超过分辨率的差异报告。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
We study agent evolution where model weights remain frozen and evolution operates only on external state (prompts, memories, skills, harnesses).
Methods that update model weights via reinforcement learning operate under distinct gradient dynamics and may face different resolution constraints.
blocks.zh:
我们研究物剂进化,其中模型重量仍然冷冻,进化只在外部状态(瞬态,记忆,技能,拉带)上运行.
通过强化学习更新模型权重的方法在不同的梯度动态下运作,可能面临不同的分辨率限制.

blocks.en:
The candidate-level evidence is evaluated on Terminal-Bench v2.1 only: the Proposal Pool in Section 5.1 evaluates n = 100 n{=}100 skills proposed from 10 Terminal-Bench training tasks across 10 disjoint test tasks, the Selection Pool in Section 5.2 evaluates n = 100 n{=}100 skills proposed from Terminal-Bench and DeepSWE trajectories across 11 tasks, and the trajectory re-evaluation in Section 5.3 covers two methods and two models.
Whether the conclusions hold for larger pools, different generation strategies, or other benchmark domains remains an open question.
blocks.zh:
候选人一级的证据只在终端-Bench v2.1上评价:第5.1节的建议书库评价10个终端-Bench培训任务中提议的10个脱节测试任务中的100个n=100个n=100个技能;第5.2节的遴选库评价N=100个n=100个N=100个N=100个技能;第5.3节的轨迹重新评价涵盖两个方法和两个模式。
这些结论是否适用于更大的集合、不同的生成战略或其他基准领域,仍然是一个未决问题。

blocks.en:
Our grid includes models up to Kimi-K3, among the strongest available at the time of writing.
We cannot rule out that future, substantially stronger models will exhibit lower evaluation noise and thereby better resolution.
In our grid, evaluation noise shrinks for stronger models mainly where their success rate approaches the ceiling, as on ALFWorld (Appendix D.1 ), which is also where little headroom remains (Appendix E.4 ); on Terminal-Bench, where headroom is large, its median stays at 3.5 to 4.0 pp for all three models.
blocks.zh:
我们的网格包括直到Kimi-K3的模型,属于编写本报告时最强的模型。
我们不能排除,未来,更强大的模式将显示出较低的评价噪音,从而提高分辨率。
在我们的网格中,评价噪声收缩了较强的模型,主要是在它们的成功率接近天花板的地方,例如ALFWorld(附录D.1),那里也留下了很少的车头(附录E.4);在终端-奔驰,它的中位数在所有三种模型中都停留在3.5至4.0pp.

blocks.en:
Seven methods, six models, and four agent benchmarks represent a broad but not exhaustive survey.
Methods that operate on fundamentally different artifact representations, or benchmarks with substantially different task structures, may exhibit different variance profiles.
blocks.zh:
7种方法、6种模式和4种代理基准代表着广泛但并非详尽的调查。
利用根本不同的文物说明或任务结构大不相同的基准的方法,可能显示出不同的概况。

blocks.en:
Program evolution, which evolves the program that solves a task and scores it deterministically, rather than the agent’s prompts, memories, skills, or harness code, has shown steadily accumulating gains in domains such as GPU kernel optimization [ 4 ] , ARC-AGI-2 [ 23 ] , and Atari policy search [ 14 ] .
This paradigm structurally reduces evaluation noise through cheap parallel re-evaluation of deterministic code and more accessible program-environment diagnostics.
Our analysis covers the current generation of text-artifact and harness evolution methods. Whether resolution similarly constrains program evolution is therefore an open question that our framework can address but our experiments do not.
blocks.zh:
程序进化(Program evolution),它演化了解决某项任务并给它定分的程序,而不是代理商的提示,记忆,技能,或牵引码,在GPU内核优化[4],ARC-AGI-2[23],Atari政策搜索[14]等领域稳步积累了收益.
这种范式在结构上通过廉价的对定型码的平行再评价以及更方便的程序环境诊断来减少评价噪音.
我们的分析涵盖当前一代的文本艺术和利用演化方法。 因此,决议是否同样制约了程序的演变是一个我们的框架可以解决的、但我们的实验却不能解决的问题。

blocks.en: Use of AI Assistants
blocks.zh: 使用人工智能助理

blocks.en: We used AI coding assistants to write experiment and analysis code. All outputs were reviewed by the authors, who take full responsibility for them. In the gain audit, an LLM agent flags candidate instructions, each of which we check by hand (Section 4.2 , Appendix E.1 ).

blocks.en: Appendix A Extended Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 扩大的相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent efforts to improve frozen LLM agents without updating model weights organize along two dimensions: the macro-structure of the evolution loop, and the object being evolved.
Along the structural dimension, methods include sequential refinement of a single skill [ 37 ] ; set-based evolution of prompt populations or agent archives [ 2 , 42 ] ; and memory- and playbook-based evolution [ 43 , 27 , 40 ] .
Along the object dimension, methods evolve non-executable text artifacts , including skills distilled from trajectories [ 24 ] , or executable code artifacts , including tools and harness components [ 18 , 42 ] .
Despite their structural variety, all such methods share the same loop: a proposer produces candidate artifacts, an evaluator scores the resulting agent, and a selector accepts higher-scoring candidates.
Our analysis applies to this shared loop, and the constraint we identify holds across representations.
blocks.zh:
近期在不更新模型权重的情况下改进冷冻LLM剂的努力沿着两个维度组织:进化圈的宏观结构,以及正在进化的对象.
在结构方面,方法包括按顺序改进单一技能[37];以固定方式发展即时人口或代理档案[2、42];以记忆和游戏本为基础的演变[43、27、40]。
沿着物体维度,方法演化出不可执行的文本文物,包括从轨迹[24]或可执行代码文物中提炼出来的技能,包括工具和牵引部件[18,42].
尽管其结构多样,但所有这些方法都有一个相同的循环:提议者生产候选文物,评价者对由此产生的代理进行评分,选择者接受得分较高的候选人。
我们的分析适用于这一共同的循环,以及我们发现的各种陈述之间的制约。

blocks.en:
A parallel line of work documents the fragility of evolving agents and the unreliability of their benchmarks. Ye et al. [39] identify sensitivity to run variance and task order; Wang et al. [34] emphasize matched-budget baselines and held-out evaluation; and Liu et al. [19] find sparse, feedback-dependent gains across evolution rounds.
SkillsBench measures the effects of curated skills across tasks [ 17 ] , while subsequent analyses examine skill-induced failures [ 7 ] and contamination from uncontrolled skill accumulation [ 29 ] .
SEAGym and continual-learning evaluations further distinguish intermediate gains from transfer, regression, and sustained improvement [ 44 , 33 ] .
blocks.zh:
平行的工作线记录了不断发展的代理人的脆弱性及其基准的不可靠性。 叶等译. [39] 确定运行差异的敏感性和任务顺序; Wang et al. [34] 强调相应的预算基线和搁置的评价; [19] 发现在进化周期中,依赖反馈的零星收益.
技能奔驰测量整个任务中受精技能的影响[17],而随后的分析则研究技能引起的失败[7]和不受控制的技能积累造成的污染[29].
SEAGM和持续学习评价进一步区分了中间收益与转移、回归和持续改进[44、33]。

blocks.en:
Noisy candidate selection relates to best-arm identification [ 12 ] and overfitting of model-selection criteria [ 3 ] .
Uncertainty-aware evaluation is also established in deep reinforcement learning [ 1 ] .
PACE directly studies false commits under repeated noisy comparisons and proposes an anytime-valid acceptance test [ 30 ] .
Our study separates evaluation noise from variation across evolution runs and uses candidate pools to examine proposal quality and selection reliability separately.
blocks.zh:
噪音大的候选人甄选涉及最佳武器识别[12]和模式甄选标准过于吻合[3]。
在深度强化学习中也确立了不确定的认知评价[1].
计算机设备行动伙伴关系通过反复的吵闹比较直接研究虚假行为,并提议随时进行有效的接受测试。
我们的研究将评价噪音与不同演化过程的差异区分开来,并使用候选人才库分别审查提案质量和选择可靠性。

blocks.en: C.1 Models and Inference
blocks.zh: C.1 模型和推论

blocks.en:
Six models span the current capability spectrum: GPT-5.4 nano [ 25 ] , GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra [ 26 ] , DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 [ 6 ] , Kimi-K3 [ 13 ] , and GLM-5.2 [ 9 , 41 ] .
Every role of a method, whether solving tasks, reflecting on failures, or rewriting the artifact, uses the same model, so no method benefits from a stronger model writing its artifacts.
On ALFWorld, SpreadsheetBench, and OfficeQA, inference uses medium reasoning effort and at most 16,384 completion tokens per call.
On Terminal-Bench, reasoning effort is left at each provider’s default.
blocks.zh:
6种型号横跨当前能力谱系:GPT-5.4纳米[25],GPT-5.6 月亮和Terra[26],DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731[6],Kimi-K3[13],以及GLM-5.2[9,41].
一种方法的每一个角色,无论是解决任务,反省失败,还是重写文物,都使用同样的模型,所以任何方法都无法从更强大的模型写出其文物中获益.
在ALFWorld,电子表格Bench,和OfficeQA上,推论使用中等推理努力,每次调用最多16,384个完成符.
在Bench终端站,每个提供商的违约都留下推理努力。

blocks.en: C.2 Methods and Evolution Budgets
blocks.zh: C.2 方法和演变预算

blocks.en:
Seven methods span two artifact families. Text-artifact methods evolve prompts, skill documents, or memory banks: SkillOpt-Lite [ 31 ] , a lightweight variant of SkillOpt [ 37 ] , GEPA [ 2 ] , Trace2Skill [ 24 ] , and ReasoningBank [ 27 ] . Harness methods evolve the agent’s own scaffolding: HarnessLens [ 36 ] edits its instructions, skills, and tool descriptions, and Meta-Harness [ 15 ] and AHE [ 18 ] edit its code.
All methods run their official implementations, and each method has the same budget on every model.
Table 2 summarizes what each method evolves, what its proposer writes, and how it decides what to accept; every validation score is one rollout per task.
On Terminal-Bench, the splits have 18 training and 18 validation tasks.
blocks.zh:
七种方法跨越两个文物家庭。 文本艺术方法演化出提示,技能文档,或记忆库: SkillOpt-Lite [31],SkillOpt [37] 的轻量级变体,GEPA [2], Trace2Skill [24],和ReasoningBank [27]. Harness方法演化了代理商自己的脚手架:HarnessLens[36]编辑其指令,技能和工具描述,Meta-Harness[15]和AHE[18]编辑其代码.
所有方法都运行着它们的官方执行,每种方法在每种模式上都有相同的预算.
表2总结了每种方法的演变,其提议者写了什么,以及它如何决定接受什么;每个验证分是每个任务一个推出.
在Terminal-Bench上,拆分有18个训练任务和18个验证任务.

blocks.en:
On ALFWorld, SpreadsheetBench, and OfficeQA, SkillOpt-Lite follows the closed-loop example of its official release and runs at most 10 rounds.
Each round proposes one edit from a rollout of 40 training tasks and accepts it if one pass over the validation split beats the current skill by at least 2 points; an edit within 2 points is kept, but the reference score is not updated.
The loop stops early after five consecutive rejected or unchanged rounds.
On Terminal-Bench, it runs 3 rounds with batches of 12 training tasks and accepts an edit only if it raises the validation score.
blocks.zh:
在ALFWorld,电子表格Bench和OfficeQA,Skill上 Opt-Lite沿用其正式发行的闭路游戏实例,最多运行10轮.
每轮提议从推出的40个训练任务中进行一次编辑,如果一次通过验证分数击败当前技能至少2分,则接受;保留2分之内的一次编辑,但参考分数不更新.
循环在连续五轮被拒绝或未改变后提前停止.
在"终端-奔驰"(Terminal-Bench)上,它运行3轮,分批完成12个训练任务,只有在提高验证分数的情况下才接受编辑.

blocks.en:
GEPA accepts a child prompt only if it beats its parent on a minibatch of 3 training tasks, scores accepted children once on the validation split, and samples parents from the per-task Pareto frontier, without merge.
Its budgets are 1,210, 829, and 939 metric calls on ALFWorld, SpreadsheetBench, and OfficeQA, and at most 128 on Terminal-Bench.
blocks.zh:
GEPA只接受一个孩子的提示,只要它在3个培训任务的小批量上打败了父母,在验证分拆上给接受过一次孩子的分数,并且从每个任务Pareto边境对父母进行抽样,而不合并.
其预算为1,210,829和939公吨的ALFWorld、电子表格Bench和OfficeQA,最多128公吨的终端Bench。

blocks.en:
Trace2Skill rolls out the training split once, writes one patch per trajectory, and merges all patches hierarchically into the skill.
ReasoningBank streams once through the training split, extracts up to three memories per task, and freezes its bank before testing.
On ALFWorld, SpreadsheetBench, and OfficeQA, neither method has score-based selection; in the loop of Figure 1 b, keeping every proposal is the degenerate selector that accepts every candidate, and like a selector driven by noisy scores, it accepts regressions along with improvements.
On Terminal-Bench, Trace2Skill rolls out each training task three times, builds three candidate skills, and keeps the one that scores best on the training split.
blocks.zh:
Trace2Skill将训练分拆一次,每个轨迹写一个补丁,并将所有补丁分级合并到技能中.
理由说明 银行流一次通过训练分拆,每次任务提取最多三个记忆,在测试前冻结银行.
在ALFWorld,电子表奔驰和OfficeQA上,两种方法都没有基于分数的选择;在图1b的循环中,保留每个建议都是接受每个候选人的堕落选择器,就像一个由吵闹的分数驱动的选择器一样,它接受回归和改进.
在Bench终端,Trace2Skill将每个培训任务推出3次,培养3个候选技能,保留在培训分数上得分最好的技能。

blocks.en:
Meta-Harness and AHE run 5 rounds, each rolling out the current harness once on the full training split.
Meta-Harness returns the candidate with the highest training score; AHE scores each of its five versions once on the validation split and returns the best.
HarnessLens has no fixed number of rounds: it compares each candidate with the current harness on 5–6 training tasks, under a cap of five passes over the training split, scores only confirmed candidates once on the validation split, and returns the initial harness if none is confirmed.
blocks.zh:
Meta-Harness和AHE运行了5轮,每轮在整场训练分裂时一次推出电流拉带.
Meta-Harness将训练分数最高的候选人返回;AHE在验证分数上每5个版本得分一次,并返回最佳成绩.
HarnessLens没有固定的轮次:它将每个候选人与目前5-6次训练任务的轮次比作5-6次训练任务的轮次,在5次通过分数的上限下,在验证分数上只给一次确认的候选人分数,如果没有确认,则返回最初的轮次.

blocks.en: C.3 Benchmarks
blocks.zh: C.3 基准

blocks.en:
Table 3 summarizes the splits, scoring, and agents.
All evolution uses the training and validation splits only; all reported scores are on the held-out test split unless stated otherwise.
blocks.zh:
表3汇总了拆分、评分和代理。
所有演化都只使用训练与验证的分数;所有报告的分数均在搁置测试分数中,除非另有说明.

blocks.en: Table 3: Benchmark splits, scoring, and agents. Scores are binary per task. Text-artifact methods and the baseline run the agent in the table; harness methods evolve the agent itself.
blocks.zh: 表3:基准划分、评分和代理。 每个任务分数为二进制. 文本艺术方法和基线在表格中运行着该剂;利用方法会演化该剂本身.

blocks.en:
We halve the released split by stratified sampling (seed 42).
The environment runs in process, and an episode succeeds when the agent completes the household goal within 50 steps.
blocks.zh:
我们通过分层取样将释放的分裂减半(种子42)。
环境运行在过程中,当代理商在50步内完成家庭目标时,一个插曲成功.

blocks.en:
We use the Verified-400 subset. One test task has no test case and scores 0 for every artifact, so scores are over all 281 test tasks and gains are unaffected.
The agent writes code that edits the workbook, run in a sandbox.
The released grader reads formula cells without recalculating them, so every formula scores as empty (Appendix E.1 ); for the variance measurement we recalculate both the predicted and the reference workbook with LibreOffice before comparison.
blocks.zh:
我们使用验证400子集。 一个测试任务没有测试案例,每件文物的分数为0,因此分数超过全部281个测试任务,得分不受影响.
代理写出编辑工作手册的代码,在沙盒中运行.
发行的分级器读取公式单元格而不重新计算它们,所以每个公式得分都是空的(Appendix E.1);对于差异度量,我们先与LibreOffice重新计算预测和参考工作手册,然后再进行比较.

blocks.en:
Questions are answered from 697 parsed U.S. Treasury Bulletins.
The agent has no web access and searches the documents with file-system tools; the parsed pages of each question’s source documents are included in the prompt.
Answers are graded by normalized exact match, the grader of the SkillOpt-Lite release.
blocks.zh:
问题由697年解析的"美国国库公报"解答.
代理服务器没有网络访问,并用文件系统工具搜索文档;每个问题源文档的解析页都包含在提示中.
答案通过规范的精确匹配进行分级,即Skillopt-Lite发行的分级.

blocks.en:
The benchmark contains 89 tasks.
For the method-level evolution and trajectory-re-evaluation experiments (Sections 4 and 5.3 ), we partition the 89 tasks into 18 training, 18 validation, and 53 held-out test tasks (Table 4 ), stratified by task difficulty so that all three splits span a balanced mix of easy, medium, and hard tasks.
Each task runs offline in its own sandbox with the official task image and timeout, and is scored by its own task-specific tests.
The baseline and the text-artifact methods run Mini-SWE-agent 2.4.6; harness methods evolve their own Mini-SWE-agent workspace, starting from version 1.14.4.
blocks.zh:
该基准包含89项任务。
对于方法层面的演化和轨迹再评价实验(第4和5.3节),我们把89项任务分为18项培训、18项验证和53项搁置测试任务(表4),按任务难度分级,使所有三项划分都跨越了简单、中和艰巨任务的均衡组合。
每个任务在自己的沙盒中以正式的任务图像和超时运行下线,通过自己的特定任务测试得分.
基线和文本渲染方法运行于迷你-SWE代理2.4.6; 利用方法从1.14.4版本开始,演化出自己的迷你-SWE代理工作空间.

blocks.en: Table 4: Terminal-Bench v2.1 training and validation splits for method-level evolution (18 tasks each, sorted alphabetically); the remaining 53 tasks form the held-out test split.
blocks.zh: 表4:终端-Bench v2.1 方法级演化的培训和验证分解(每个18项任务,按字母排序);其余53项任务构成搁置测试分解.

blocks.en:
For the candidate-level experiments in Section 5 , we construct two pools of n = 100 n{=}100 skills (Appendix F.1 ).
The Proposal Pool (Section 5.1 ) generates 100 skills offline from execution trajectories on 10 Terminal-Bench v2.1 training tasks and evaluates them across 10 disjoint test tasks to measure out-of-sample proposal gains.

blocks.en:
Model coverage follows cost.
The text-artifact methods on ALFWorld, SpreadsheetBench, and OfficeQA, the cheapest setting, use all six models.
Two settings are far more expensive than the rest. Harness methods write and debug code at every evolution step, and one harness evolution run consumes a median of 26M tokens. On Terminal-Bench, every task is a long interactive episode in its own container: one evolution run consumes about 43M tokens, and evaluating each resulting artifact takes another 424 containerized episodes (53 test tasks × \times 8 repetitions). We therefore run these settings on a subset of the models.

blocks.en: D.3 Margins Reported in Agent-Evolution Papers
blocks.zh: D.3 代理进化文件报告的边际

blocks.en: To place our noise estimates against the differences that papers claim, we surveyed the results reported in agent-evolution papers.
blocks.zh: 为了将我们的噪音估计与论文所声称的分歧进行对比,我们调查了在代理人-革命文件中报告的结果。

blocks.en:
We include the papers introducing the seven methods we evaluate (GEPA [ 2 ] , Trace2Skill [ 24 ] , ReasoningBank [ 27 ] , SkillOpt-Lite [ 31 ] , Meta-Harness [ 15 ] , HarnessLens [ 36 ] , and AHE [ 18 ] ), together with ACE [ 43 ] and SkillOpt [ 37 ] , two methods that these papers build on or compare against.
From each paper we take the main results tables, listed in Table 8 ; ablations, analyses, and appendix tables are not included.
blocks.zh:
我们包括介绍我们评价的七种方法的文件(GEPA[2]、Trace2Skill[24]、ReasoningBank[27]、Skill) Opt-Lite [31],Meta-Harness [15],HarnessLens [36],和AHE [18],连同ACE [43]和SkillOpt [37],这些论文所借鉴或比较的两种方法.
从每份文件中,我们取表8所列的主要结果表;不包括清单、分析和附录表。

blocks.en:
Each column of a results table, that is, one benchmark evaluated with one model in one setting, gives one record.
For each record we take, from the table, the score of the proposed method, the score of its strongest competitor in the same column, and the score of the unoptimized baseline, and, from the text and captions, the number of evolution runs behind the reported score and whether an error bar or variance estimate is given.
A competitor is another optimization method (prompt, skill, memory, or harness optimization); zero-shot prompting, human-written prompts or harnesses, and fixed retrieval baselines are not competitors.
We use accuracy-type metrics only (accuracy, success rate, pass@1, task-goal completion), expressed in percentage points, and skip columns that average other columns of the same table, so that no result is counted twice.
This gives 178 columns, 171 of which have an optimization competitor.
The margin of a column is the score of the proposed method minus that of its strongest competitor; the gain is the score of the proposed method minus that of the unoptimized baseline.
blocks.zh:
成果表的每栏,即一个基准和一个模式在一个设定中评价,都有一个记录。
对于每一记录,我们从表格中取出拟议方法的得分、同一栏中最强竞争者的得分和未优化基线的得分,从文字和标题中取出报告分数后面的演化数,以及是否给出错误栏或差异估计。
竞争者是另一种优化方法(即时,技能,内存,或拉带优化);零镜头提示,人写提示或拉带,固定的检索基线不是竞争者.
我们只使用精确类型的衡量标准(准确性、成功率、通过@1、任务目标完成率),以百分点表示,并跳过同一表格中平均其他列的列,因此不计算结果两次。
这使178列,其中171列具有优化竞争对手.
一栏的比值是拟议方法的比值减去最强竞争者的比值;得值是拟议方法的比值减去未优化基线的比值.

blocks.en:
Across the 171 columns, the median margin is 3.4 pp (interquartile range 1.2–6.6; quartiles by linear interpolation), and the median gain over the unoptimized baseline is 9.3 pp.
The median margin is stable across subsets.
Taking the median within each paper first gives 3.0 pp (interquartile range 2.0–3.8 across papers); excluding Mind2Web, the benchmark with the most columns, gives 3.5; and restricting the survey to the 52 columns on the four benchmarks we measure (SpreadsheetBench, OfficeQA, ALFWorld, and Terminal-Bench) also gives 3.5, so Section 4.1 uses the full-survey quartiles.
None of the 178 columns reports an error bar or a variance estimate.
Only the six Trace2Skill columns average over several evolution runs (three seeds); 20 columns state a single run, and the remaining 152 do not state the number of runs and report a single score.
Competitor scores also depend on who runs them: in four of the papers, the strongest competitor scores at or below the unoptimized baseline on some columns (15 in total).
blocks.zh:
在171栏中,中值比值为3.4pp(中间值比值为1.2-6.6;以线性插值表示的四分位数),高于未优化基线的中值增益为9.3pp。
各个子集的中位差是稳定的.
使用每份文件中的中位数首先给出3.0pp(中间范围为2.0-3.8,跨文件);不包括Mind2Web,该基准的列数最多,则给出3.5;将调查限制在我们衡量的四个基准(Spreadshet Bench、OfficeQA、ALFWorld和Terminal-Bench)上的52列,也给出3.5,因此,第4.1节使用完整的调查四分法。
178栏中没有任何栏报告错误栏或差异估计数。
只有六个 Trace2Skill列平均在几个进化运行(3个种子);20列显示一次运行,其余152列没有说明运行次数并报告一次得分.
竞争对手的分数也取决于谁操作它们:在四篇论文中,最强的竞争对手的分数达到或低于某些栏目的未优化基线(共15分).

blocks.zh: E.1 审计设计

blocks.en:
The audit covers three of the four benchmarks of our variance grid (all but Terminal-Bench) and the nine further benchmarks on which the original papers of the audited methods report optimized artifacts: HotpotQA [ 38 ] , PUPA [ 16 ] , HoVer [ 11 ] , IFBench [ 28 ] , AIME 2025, and LiveBench-Math [ 35 ] from GEPA [ 2 ] , and LiveMathematicianBench [ 10 ] , SearchQA [ 8 ] , and DocVQA [ 21 ] from the skills released with SkillOpt-Lite [ 31 ] .
On the grid benchmarks the reported gain is that of our own evolved artifacts (the best method, averaged over evolution runs); elsewhere it is the gain of the released artifact when transferred to our models, which is typically smaller than the gain reported for the model it was optimized on.
All tests use GPT-5.4 nano, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and GPT-5.6 Luna; gains are paired by task and averaged over at least two evaluation repetitions (four or more except on SearchQA).
DeepSeek-V4-Flash does not accept image input, so DocVQA uses the other two models.
For GPT-5.4 nano on OfficeQA we did not run the repaired evaluation: its reported gain, 1.0 point, is within noise.
blocks.zh:
审计涵盖了我们差异网格的四个基准(除了终端-奔驰)中的三个,以及被审计方法的原始文件报告优化了文物的另外九个基准:HotpotQA [38],PUPA [16],HoVer [11],IF Bench [28],AIME 2025,以及GEPA [2]的Live Bench-Math [35],以及LiveMathematician Bench [10],SearingQA [8],以及DCVQA [21] 与Skillopt-Lite一同发布的技能[31].
在网格基准上,报告的收益是我们自己进化的文物(最佳方法,在进化过程中的平均值);在其他地方,它是在转移到我们的模型时释放出来的文物的收益,这通常比它所优化的模型所报告的收益要小。
所有测试都使用GPT-5.4纳米,DeepSeek-V4-Flash,以及GPT-5.6 Luna;增益按任务配对,平均至少重复两次评价(除搜索QA外,四次或四次以上).
DeepSeek-V4-Flash不接受图像输入,因此DocVQA使用另外两种模式.
办公室GPT-5.4纳米 QA我们没有运行 修复的评估: 据报道,它的增益,1.0点, 是在噪音中。

blocks.en:
The large gains are not specific to our setup. SkillOpt-Lite reports gains of 36 to 45 pp on SpreadsheetBench for the four GPT-5 models it evaluates (+36.3 pp on GPT-5.4 nano) and 20 to 37 pp on LiveMathematicianBench [ 31 ] .
Our runs show gains of the same size: 29 to 38 pp on SpreadsheetBench with the artifacts evolved in our grid, and 27 to 37 pp on LiveMathematicianBench with the skills released with SkillOpt-Lite (Table 11 ).
blocks.zh:
巨额收益并不具体属于我们的设置。 技能 Opt-Lite报告,电子表格Bench对它评价的四个GPT-5型号的收获为36至45页(GPT-5.4纳米的+36.3页),LiveMathematician Bench的收获为20至37页[31].
我们的运行显示了同样规模的收益:在电子表格Bench上29至38页与我们网格中进化的文物,在Live Mathematician Bench上27至37页与SkillOpt-Lite发布的技能(表11).

blocks.en:
For each benchmark, an LLM agent first went through the artifacts, those released with GEPA and SkillOpt-Lite and those evolved in our grid, instruction by instruction and flagged the instructions that could explain the gain; we then checked each flagged instruction by hand against the artifacts and the benchmark’s evaluation, and wrote the one that appeared most responsible as a single rule before running the test. The rule was not revised after seeing results.
The rule is appended to the unevolved baseline, which is otherwise unchanged.
Because the rule is chosen after inspecting the artifacts, the test shows that one sentence is sufficient to obtain the gain, not that the artifacts contain nothing else.
Table 10 lists the rules.
blocks.zh:
对每个基准来说,一个LLM剂首先通过文物,那些与GEPA和SkillOpt-Lite一起发布的,以及那些在我们网格中演化出来的,通过指令指示并标出能够解释收益的指令;然后我们对照文物和基准的评价,用手检查每个标注指令,并在进行测试之前写下一个似乎最负责任的指令。 该规则在看到结果后没有修订。
该规则附在未变动的基准之后,否则不变。
由于该规则是在检查文物后选择的,因此测试表明,一句话就足以获得收益,而不是文物中没有任何其他内容.
表10列出了规则。

blocks.en:
A repair either restores the benchmark’s official evaluation where the method’s port departed from it, or replaces surface-form matching with grading by meaning (Table 9 ).
Semantic grading counts an answer as correct if it matches exactly or if two LLM judges (DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GPT-5.6 Luna), shown only the question, the reference answer, and the extracted answer, both accept it.
We found no shortcut in the released evaluations of ALFWorld, PUPA, HoVer, and IFBench, so they have no repaired results.
blocks.zh:
修补要么在方法的端口偏离时恢复基准的正式评价,要么用意义来取代表面形态的评级(表9)。
语义分级法将一个答案算为正确,如果它完全匹配,或者如果两个LLM判官(DeepSeek-V4-Flash和GPT-5.6 Luna)只显示问题,参考答案,以及提取的答案,两者都接受.
在公布的ALFWorld,PUPA,HoVer,以及IF Bench的评价中,我们没有发现任何捷径,所以没有修复的结果.

blocks.zh: 表9:公布的评价及其修复中的快捷键。

blocks.en: E.2 Per-Benchmark Results
blocks.zh: E.2 人均基准结果

blocks.en:
In Figure 3 , each point is one model–benchmark pair and the horizontal axis is the gain under the evaluation released with the method; QA benchmarks ( † \dagger ) are OfficeQA, HotpotQA, SearchQA, and DocVQA, and math benchmarks ( ‡ \ddagger ) are AIME 2025, LiveMathematicianBench, and LiveBench-Math.
Benchmarks with no shortcut found have no repaired result and appear only in panel (a), except IFBench, which has no one-rule result either.
Figure 8 expands Figure 3 into one bar per model and benchmark, and Table 11 lists the scores behind both figures.
Where the evaluation admits a shortcut, the reported gain (gray) is matched by the one-rule baseline (black tick) and shrinks to near zero under the repaired evaluation (green).
The dotted line marks the headroom left after repair, one hundred minus the repaired baseline: on several benchmarks the reported gain exceeds this headroom, so it cannot reflect a gain in the capability the benchmark intends to measure.
The one-rule test does not reproduce every gain; the paragraphs below discuss the exceptions.
blocks.zh:
在图3中,每个点是一个模型–基准对,水平轴是随方法发布的评价下的收益;QA基准(QQ\dagger)是OfficeQA,HotpotQA,SearchQA,和DocVQA,数学基准(QQ\\ddagger)是AIME 2025,Live Mathematician Bench,和Live Bench-Math.
没有找到捷径的基准没有修复结果,只出现在面板(a)中,但IF Bench除外,它也没有单一规则的结果。
图8 图3为每个模型和基准的一个栏,表11列出了这两个数字后面的分数。
在评价承认捷径的情况下,报告的增益(gray)与单规则基线(黑勾)相匹配,并在修复的评价(绿色)下缩小到接近零.
虚线标记了修理后留下的房头,100减去修理后的基线:在若干基准上,所报告的收益超过这个房头,因此无法反映基准打算衡量的能力的增益。
单一规则的标准并不重复每一项收益;以下段落讨论例外。

blocks.en:
On HoVer, whose gains come from multi-hop retrieval strategies, one sentence recovers only 43% and 41% of the gain for GPT-5.4 nano and GPT-5.6 Luna.
For DeepSeek-V4-Flash, a single retrieval rule, to name the entities whose pages are still missing, recovers 91%, so for this model the retrieval improvement itself fits in one sentence.
On HotpotQA, a gain of 5 to 8 pp survives the repair; it also comes from better retrieval (Appendix E.4 ).
blocks.zh:
在HoVer上,他从多跳检索策略中获得了收益,其中一句话只回收了GPT-5.4纳米和GPT-5.6 Luna的43%和41%的收益.
对于DeepSeek-V4-Flash,一个单一的检索规则,来命名其页面仍然缺失的实体,回收了91%,所以对于这个模型,检索改进本身适合在一个句子中.
在HotpotQA上,5至8pp的增益在修复中幸存;它也来自更好的检索(Appendix E.4 .

blocks.en:
More often, the gain does come from a shortcut but the model does not act on a single sentence.
On ALFWorld with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the rule recovers only 30% of the gain because the model does not follow the search procedure, while the longer evolved artifact does change its behavior.
On LiveMathematicianBench, with the rule the models choose the stronger-result option on 4%, 54%, and 27% of the questions where it is correct, against 67%, 86%, and 92% with the evolved skill, so the rule recovers 0% to 51% of the gain, while the repaired gain stays near zero for both.
The skill differs from the rule in four ways: it gives a reason, that the concrete options are “almost always deliberately understated”; it makes the stronger-result option the default unless a concrete option can be argued to be sharp; it lists the wordings under which that option appears; and it repeats the instruction just before the final answer.
Evolution thus optimizes not only which shortcut to take but also how to state it so that the model takes it.
blocks.zh:
更常见的是,收益确实来自快捷键,但模型不会在单句上发挥作用.
在带有DeepSeek-V4-Flash的ALFWorld上,该规则只恢复了30%的收益,因为模型没有遵循搜索程序,而进化时间较长的文物确实改变了它的行为.
在LiveMathematician Bench上,根据规则,模型选择了4%,54%,27%的正确问题,67%,86%,92%的进化技能,因此规则恢复了0%至51%的收益,而修复后的收益两者都保持了接近零。
技能在四个方面与规则不同:它给出了一个理由,即具体选项“几乎总是被故意低估”;它使更强成果选项成为默认选项,除非可以认为具体选项是尖锐的;它列出了该选项出现的措辞;它在最后答案之前就重复了指示。
因此,进化不仅优化了要采取的捷径,而且优化了如何说明以便模型采用。

blocks.en:
On AIME 2025 with GPT-5.6 Luna, the rule scores higher than the evolved artifact (69.3 versus 51.0): both adapt to a parser that credits only a bare integer, but the rule removes more of the answers the parser fails to read.
On SearchQA the rule recovers 45% to 78% of the gain, but under semantic grading it lowers the score of GPT-5.4 nano by 2.0 pp relative to the unevolved baseline: semantic grading credits hedged answers such as “George Calvert (the 1st Lord Baltimore)”, whereas a model told to write only the shortest span sometimes keeps the wrong part.
blocks.zh:
在与GPT-5.6 Luna的AIME 2025上,规则得分高于进化的文物(69.3对51.0):两者都适应一个只有赤整数的解析器,但规则删除了更多的解析器未能读取的答案.
在SearchQA上,规则回收了45%至78%的收益,但在语义分级下,相对于未演化基线,它将GPT-5.4纳米的分数比2.0 pp降低:语义分级信用套期回答如“George Calvert(巴尔的摩第一勋爵)”,而一个只写最短长度的模型有时会保留错误的部分。

blocks.en:
IFBench has neither a one-rule result nor a repaired result, for two reasons.
Its released evaluation checks each instruction with code, and grading the same outputs more strictly, on the model’s original response only, makes the gains larger rather than smaller, so we found no shortcut to repair and no requirement of the evaluation that a single rule could state.
Its gains are also small, 2.7 to 3.8 pp, comparable to the single-run standard deviation measured in Section 4.1 , so the share of such a gain recovered by one rule could not be interpreted.
We keep IFBench in the figure as an example of the small improvements that remain when a gain does not come from a shortcut.
LiveBench-Math has no one-rule result because its gains are too small: under the released evaluation they are 0.9, 1.3, and 3.9 pp, and only the last has a 95% confidence interval that excludes zero, so the share recovered by one rule could not be interpreted.
blocks.zh:
由于两个原因,IF Bench既无一规则结果,也无修复结果。
它发布的评价用代码检查每个指令,并且更严格地根据模型的原始反应来评定相同的产出,使得收益更大而不是更小,因此我们发现没有捷径可以修复,也没有要求评价一个单一的规则可以说明。
其收益也很小,2.7至3.8pp,与第4.1节所测的单跑标准差相当,因此无法解释按一条规则回收的这种收益的份额。
我们把IFBench放在图中,作为当收益不是从捷径中产生时,仍然有小的改进的例子。
Live Bench-Math没有单一规则的结果,因为其收益太小:在发布的评价下,它们是0.9,1.3,和3.9pp,只有最后一个有95%的置信间隔排除0,因此一个规则回收的份额无法解释.

blocks.en: E.3 Re-evolving Under Repaired Evaluations
blocks.zh: E.3 修复评价下的重现

blocks.en:
Re-scoring released artifacts leaves open whether evolution, given a repaired evaluation from the start, would find gains of its own.
We therefore re-run evolution with the repaired evaluation used for training feedback, validation, and testing (Table 12 ).
On OfficeQA and SpreadsheetBench, the re-evolved text-artifact methods gain at most 1.9 pp over the repaired baseline, except for SkillOpt-Lite with DeepSeek-V4-Flash on SpreadsheetBench (+5.8 pp), whose artifacts avoid spreadsheet functions the recalculation engine does not support.
On these two benchmarks we re-evolve GEPA and SkillOpt-Lite only with DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GPT-5.6 Luna, which already show that the large gains under the released evaluations do not return.
On LiveMathematicianBench, the leaked option can only be balanced during evolution, so that it is correct half the time where it appears (Appendix E.5 ); this halves rather than removes the shortcut.
On the full balanced test set, DeepSeek-V4-Flash gains 5.2 pp with GEPA and 3.8 pp with SkillOpt-Lite, but the gains come entirely from questions that contain the option, and on the questions without it no configuration improves significantly.
HotpotQA is the exception: GEPA improves retrieval for all three models under either evaluation (Appendix E.4 ).
blocks.zh:
重新评分所释放的文物会让进化过程从一开始,经过修复的评价,是否会发现自己的收益.
因此,我们通过用于培训反馈、鉴定和测试的修复评价,重新进行演变(表12)。
在OfficeQA和Electivesheet Bench上,重新演变的文本渲染法最多比修补后的基线增加1.9页,除了SkillOpt-Lite在Easteek-V4-Flash上使用DeepSeek Bench(+5.8页)外,其文物避免了电子表格的功能,重新计算引擎不支持.
在这两个基准上,我们只用DeepSeek-V4-Flash和GPT-5.6 Luna重新开发了GEPA和Skillopt-Lite,这些基准已经表明,在所发布的评价下取得的巨大收益不会回归。
在LiveMathematician Bench上,被泄露的选项只有在进化过程中才能平衡,这样它出现的时间的一半才是正确的(附录E.5);这可以半途而废,而不是去掉快捷键.
在完全平衡的测试集上,DeepSeek-V4-Flash与GEPA的得分5.2pp,与SkillOpt-Lite的得分3.8pp,但得分完全来自包含选项的问题,在没有选项的问题上,配置没有显著改善.
HotpotQA是例外:GEPA改进了两种评价下所有三种模型的检索(附录E.4 )。

blocks.en:
SpreadsheetBench also shows why adapting to a shortcut is learned only when the gain from it is large.
Writing values instead of formulas is worth about 30 pp under the released grader, and all eight runs of SkillOpt-Lite with GPT-5.4 nano discover it.
Under the repaired grader the same rule is still worth about 6 pp, because some formulas use functions LibreOffice cannot evaluate, but on a 39-task validation set this is two or three tasks, comparable to run-to-run noise.
Only 2 of the 12 artifacts re-evolved under the repaired grader keep the behavior, although half of them state the rule in their text.
blocks.zh:
电子表格 法官座席还表明,为什么只有在从捷径获得巨大收益时才学会适应捷径。

在修复的分级器下重新演化的12件文物中,只有2件保留了行为,尽管其中一半在文字中陈述了规则.

blocks.en:
We also re-evolve HarnessLens, Meta-Harness, and AHE under the repaired evaluations on ALFWorld, SpreadsheetBench, and OfficeQA with GPT-5.4 nano, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and GPT-5.6 Luna, with 8 evolution runs and 8 evaluations each (Table 12 ).
On SpreadsheetBench and OfficeQA the gains are at most 9 pp, and HarnessLens returns its initial harness in 47 of 71 runs.
Two larger gains need care.
On ALFWorld, Meta-Harness and AHE improve DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GPT-5.6 Luna by 16 to 32 pp, because the initial agent keeps only the last two steps of its history; one run that changes nothing but this setting gains 29 pp.
On SpreadsheetBench, AHE gains 11 to 13 pp for these two models on the 151 of 281 tasks whose instructions ask for a formula, because the grader compares values and writing the computed value passes, but only 3 to 4 pp on the other tasks.
Both gains come from a single change that helps most tasks at once, the kind of gain that evolution can identify.
blocks.zh:
我们还将HarnessLens、Meta-Harness和AHE重新纳入ALFWorld、电子表格Bench和OfficeQA的修复评价中,包括GPT-5.4纳米、DeepSeek-V4-Flash和GPT-5.6 Luna,各有8个演化运行和8个评价(表12)。
在电子表格Bench和OfficeQA上,收益最多为9pp,HarnessLens在71跑中的47跑中返回了它的初始控制带.
两个更大的收益需要注意。
在ALFWorld上,Meta-Harness和AHE在16至32页前改进了DeepSeek-V4-Flash和GPT-5.6 Luna,因为最初的代理只保留了它历史的最后两个步骤;一次运行除了这个设定增益了29页之外,没有什么变化.
在电子表格Bench上,AHE在指示要求公式的281项任务的151项上为这两个模型获得了11至13页,因为分级器比较了数值并写入了计算值的差数,但在其他任务上只有3至4页.
这两种收益都来自一次单一的改变,一次帮助大多数任务,即进化可以识别的那种收益.

blocks.en: E.4 Headroom After Repair
blocks.zh: E.4 修理后的会议室

blocks.en:
Repairing an evaluation also shows how much room a benchmark leaves for evolution.
Terminal-Bench, which we did not audit, is included under its released evaluation.
blocks.zh:
修复一项评价还表明基准为演变留下了多少余地。
我们没有审计的终极奔驰号被列在公布的评价中。

blocks.en:
On two benchmarks, the score can be earned without the capability the benchmark is meant to test. • SearchQA: closed-book knowledge instead of retrieval. The benchmark is meant to test answering from retrieved search snippets, but the models answer as well without them.
Under semantic grading, removing all snippets changes the score from 84.2 to 81.9 for GPT-5.4 nano, from 89.4 to 90.2 for DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and from 89.8 to 90.7 for GPT-5.6 Luna.
Snippets help only on the 126 of 1,400 questions whose snippets come from question-bank sites and contain both the clue and the answer.
The remaining errors say little about the models: of 100 residual errors, which we attributed with an LLM and spot-checked by hand, 36 stem from wrong or ambiguous gold answers, such as Jeopardy clues that lost their category, or from answers that are in fact acceptable.
The benchmark cannot even separate DeepSeek-V4-Flash from GPT-5.6 Luna ( − 0.4 -0.4 pp, 95% CI [ − 1.5 , 0.8 ] [-1.5,0.8] ), and the released skill adds at most 1.6 pp. • LiveMathematicianBench: one option is always correct. The benchmark turns theorems from recent arXiv papers into five-option questions that ask for the strongest statement that can be proved.

Across the 177 questions of the released splits, this option appears in 85 and is the correct answer in all 85; it appears in 46 of the 106 test questions.
For example, one test question is built from the theorem that every flow-admissible, cyclically 5-edge-connected, cubic signed graph has a nowhere-zero 6-flow.

A model that always picks this option answers all 46 such test questions correctly without reading the mathematics, and the released skill’s entire gain comes from these questions.
On the 60 test questions without the option, the baselines are 50–61, yet no artifact improves on them; with 60 questions the confidence interval is about ± \pm 5 pp.

blocks.en: On several benchmarks the baseline, or the baseline plus one sentence, is already close to full marks once answers are graded correctly, so evolution has little left to gain. • DocVQA. blocks.en:
Three benchmarks keep a gain that the repair does not remove, and in each case its source can be named.
On HotpotQA, GEPA keeps 5.5–7.6 pp under semantic grading, and re-evolution traces the gain to retrieval: recall of supporting articles rises by about 10 pp.
On SpreadsheetBench, 5.7–6.7 pp survive LibreOffice recalculation, but the re-evolved artifacts that keep a gain do so by adapting to the recalculation engine, writing values and avoiding unsupported functions.
On HoVer, gains of 8–13 pp come from retrieval strategies.
These are the small, specific improvements whose identification Section 5 examines.

关于HoVer,8–13页的收益来自检索策略.
这些是第5节审查的小型具体改进。

blocks.en: E.5 Scope of the Audit
blocks.zh: E.5 审计范围

blocks.en:
The audit tests whether the largest reported gains need more than a single rule; it does not show that an evolved artifact contains nothing else of value.
Because we wrote each rule after inspecting the artifacts, the test shows that one rule is enough to reproduce a gain, not that the gain requires this rule, and HoVer shows that the test fails when a gain is spread over several strategies.
The artifacts released with GEPA were evolved for GPT-4.1-mini, so their gains on our models are smaller than those in the original paper; we therefore compare, on the same model, the gain under the released evaluation with the one-rule result and with the repaired gain.
Finally, a repair can be incomplete.
For re-evolution on LiveMathematicianBench, we balance the leaked option: in as many questions as it is correct in, we replace a wrong option with its text, so that it is correct only half the time where it appears.
Half is still more often than the models answer these questions correctly (about 34% for DeepSeek-V4-Flash), so choosing the option remains profitable, and balancing only halves its benefit.
We therefore score capability only on the questions that do not contain the option.
blocks.zh:
审计检验报告的最大收益是否需要一个以上的规则;它没有显示进化的文物中没有任何其他价值。
因为我们在检查了文物后写了每个规则,测试显示一个规则足以复制一个收益,而不是收益需要这个规则,而HoVer显示当一个收益分布在几个策略上时测试失败.
与GEPA一同发布的文物是GPT-4.1-mini的进化,因此它们对我们模型的收获比原始论文的收获要小;因此,我们在同一模型上,将发布的评价下的收益与单规则结果和修复后的收益进行比较.
最后,修复可能不完整。
对于Live Mathematician Bench的再演进,我们平衡了被泄露的选项:在很多问题中,只要它是正确的,我们就用它的文本来替换一个错误的选项,这样它就只出现的一半时间是正确的.
一半仍然比模型更经常地正确回答这些问题(DeepSeek-V4-Flash大约为34%),因此选择这个选项仍然是有利可图的,并且只平衡其收益的一半.
因此,我们只能对不包含这一选择的问题进行评分。

blocks.en: Sections 5.1 and 5.2 evaluate two fixed pools of n = 100 n{=}100 skills designed for the two stages of candidate-level evaluation: the Proposal Pool , which tests out-of-sample skill transfer from 10 training tasks to 10 disjoint test tasks, and the Selection Pool , which benchmarks selectors and trajectory judges across 11 difficulty-stratified tasks.

To evaluate proposal quality without selection in the loop, an offline SkillOpt-Lite-based proposer using DeepSeek-V4-Flash generates n = 100 n{=}100 standalone skills from 78 execution trajectories across 10 Terminal-Bench v2.1 training tasks (kv-store-grpc, pypi-server, sqlite-db-truncate, path-tracing, filter-js-from-html, torch-tensor-parallelism, dna-insert, mcmc-sampling-stan, bn-fit-modify, tune-mjcf) following the protocol below.
Each skill is then evaluated 16 times on each of 10 disjoint Terminal-Bench v2.1 test tasks (configure-git-webserver, break-filter-js-from-html, query-optimize, dna-assembly, rstan-to-pystan, vulnerable-secret, mailman, db-wal-recovery, torch-pipeline-parallelism, path-tracing-reverse), totaling 100 × 10 × 16 = 16,000 100\times 10\times 16=16{,}000 solver rollouts with binary whole-task rewards under native task verifiers.

blocks.en:
To generate n = 100 n{=}100 distinct offline candidate skills from the training trajectories without an outer selection loop, the proposer launches parallel research sub-agents that inspect failure mechanisms on the training corpus and verify candidate fixes with small local probes.
Below is the research and skill-authoring prompt used to synthesize the n = 100 n{=}100 standalone skills in the Proposal Pool.
blocks.zh:
为了生成n = 100 n = 100 从培训轨迹中区分出候选人的技能,而无需外部选择循环,提议者会发射平行的研究子代理,以检查培训仪器上的故障机制,用小型本地探测器验证候选人的修补.
